integrity: The stated lattice, semigroup, fan, and orbit-closure arguments provide the mathematical proof. No independent mathematical audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns reduced singular support and reduced set-theoretic intersections, not intersection schemes or their multiplicities.
Finite verification through n=7 corroborates but cannot prove the all-parameter theorem.
A prior local-chart result already covers the binomial charts and purity of the singular support; only global incidence and component geometry are proposed as new.
Possible equivalent global incidence statements in unindexed literature remain an originality risk.
title: Global intersection nerve of singular components in cycle graphical-zonotope toric varieties
